title: 論理回路
subtitle: Logic Circuits
keywords: Boolean Algebra 2.Combinational Logic Circuit 3.Memory Circuits 4.Sequential Circuit 5.Logic Circuit Simulator
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic logic circuits consisting of commonly used circuit components. (2) learn the actions of logical gates and flip-flop. (3) learn the basic design approach of logic circuits.
advice: This is the basic course of computer architecture. We will cover the following materials: 1. Characteristics of logical gates. 2. Truth table for given a logic circuit. 3. Simplification of a logic circuit using a Karnaugh map. 4. Circuit architecture and design methodology of encoders, decoders, data selectors, multiplexers, coincidence circuits, binary adders, flip-flops, shift registers, and counters. Students are required to calculate binary numbers. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and characteristics. Students are expected to understand actions of logical circuits using a logic circuit simulator. Students are expected to review each course content.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of binary arithmetic is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate positive and negative binary numbers.
Be able to explain the actions of logic circuits consisting of logic gates such as AND, OR, and NOT.
Be able to explain the actions of cascaded decoders.
Be able to explain a data latch mechanism using various flip-flops.
Be able to design an accumulator circuit with adders and general-purpose registers.
Be able to design a shift register and counter circuits with a combination of flip-flops.
